results.title: Year of the Little Tiger
results.overview: It’s Chinese New year in Wellington, and Daniel, a Chinese-Pākehā teenager, is feeling insecure about being half Chinese. After being bullied by his Chinese peers, he realises how out of touch he is with his own culture and begins to feel lost within his mixed identity. All Daniel wants is to get closer to his crush Kaya, a headstrong Chinese girl, but his insecurities are getting in his way. How will Daniel find the courage to be proud of his mixed identity and confess to his crush?

results.title: local color
results.overview: Local Color documents the daily life of people who live, work, visit and play in Hanoi. Once the central city of America’s most elusive enemy during the Cold War, the film asks what is to become of the red that once brought the western world to its knees? Where is it fading? What colors replace it? Who will be responsible moving forward? Local Color is an observational documentary that investigates the limits of observational documentary. Starting with a relic of the Vietnam War, Local Color expands to explore how images, propaganda and a local scene is created.  Local Color is a film about labor and leisure. It is about the past, the present and the future and it is a film about a city and its people. Local Color a film about Hanoi, Vietnam.

results.title: Zindabad
results.overview: In the heart of the Karakoram, a Pakistani climber attempts a first ascent in his own backyard, where the biggest peaks have long been claimed by outsiders. Set against the long shadow of 9/11, which reshaped access, perception, and opportunity across Pakistan’s mountains, the expedition becomes a lens on a deeper imbalance. Mueez’s climb is an attempt to shift that dynamic, and to imagine a future where the next generation of Pakistani alpinists define their own routes, on their own terms.

results.title: Atheer
results.overview: In a quiet market, a perfume seller is given a few bottles by a mysterious old woman. As customers begin to react in unexpected ways, his curiosity turns into unease, leading him to follow her into the unknown.

results.title: What’s Forgivable
results.overview: A picture arrives on Jasim’s doorstep with a message threatening his family. Left with no choice, Jasim sets off into the night to carry out their demands.

results.title: ROYA
results.overview: A taxi driver discovers a pair of AI-powered glasses that reveal glimpses of the life he might have lived. Drawn into visions of abandoned dreams and choices never made, he enters a surreal landscape built from his unrealised possibilities. The journey forces him to confront the distance between the life he imagined and the one he chose.

results.title: Reflection
results.overview: After losing his father, Ahmed becomes trapped in isolation, grief, and emotional numbness. On the night of his birthday, while standing on the edge of suicide, an unexpected phone call and a mysterious girl named Layan pull him back from making a fatal decision. Her words give him a small sense of hope and connection he has not felt since his father’s death. As Ahmed struggles to reconnect with reality, his mental state begins to deteriorate. He starts hearing voices, seeing disturbing visions, and encountering a mysterious double of himself that seems to represent his inner darkness and unresolved trauma. Torn between healing and self-destruction, Ahmed is forced to confront his grief, loneliness, and fractured identity before losing himself completely. “Reflection” is a psychological drama that explores loss, depression, isolation, and the silent battle within the human mind.

results.title: Manama Cairo
results.overview: A young man plans to get married in Cairo, but a short trip turns into an unexpected adventure after he forgets the address he needs to reach. Amid strange situations and surprising encounters, his journey becomes one of self-discovery and purpose, in a story filled with comedy and simplicity.

results.title: East in the West
results.overview: The Story of the Cowboy in Bahrain follows a Bahraini man whose fascination with American cowboy culture has become part of his everyday life. Through his experience, the documentary looks at how a passion born far from its original setting can cross borders and take on a new meaning. The film captures an unusual meeting of cultures and the personal identity that grows from it.

results.title: Crime 0
results.overview: Trapped in isolation, a crime novelist becomes consumed by the world of his final manuscript as the boundaries between fiction and reality slowly dissolve. Haunted by guilt, loss, and the search for truth, he is forced into a confrontation that may become the final chapter of his life.

results.title: The Last Seen
results.overview: Inside a silent home, presence slowly turns into absence. As time distorts and emotions fade, what once felt alive begins to disappear.

results.title: Los portadores (heraldos neón)
results.overview: New short by Bruno Varela (Mexico City, 1971), an experimental film and found-footage artist based in Oaxaca.

results.title: forming en route
results.overview: At various paces and rhythms, a portrait of a French estuary town unfolds - a study of how light falls on a locale and its various aspects. As we wander from place to place through reflections and shadows, intermittently entering into different worlds, we notice how the activities of the inhabitants shape our experience of the environment. The people, architecture, weather, the everyday details, given equal significance in forming the landscape of the film with a dreamlike inner logic.

results.title: Stars Above Us
results.overview: A man reflects on his teenage years and the deep bond he had with a friend who, despite being bullied and struggling with severe depression, seemed untouchable in his eyes. As he looks back on their time together, he grapples with her tragic death and the haunting memories of the girl he thought was the coolest person in the world.

results.title: Paseo al Parque
results.overview: A walk through the Parc des Buttes-Chaumont. As sunlight bathes the trees and the bodies of those strolling through the park, a low-resolution cellphone camera struggles to process the light.

results.title: MGP: The Untamed Circuit
results.overview: This film centers on the 2025 Macau Grand Prix, telling the story of world-famous racers competing on the Guia Circuit. It also weaves together the history of the 72 editions of the event, showing the changes and constants of the Macau Grand Prix, and highlighting the development achievements of China’s automotive industry and motorsport events.

results.title: Performance of the Year
results.overview: Olivia, a struggling actor, is forced into the biggest audition of her career with the last director she'd ever work for. Her whole life is turned upside down when she is pushed to her limits for this pretentious director's masterpiece.

results.title: The Date
results.overview: Jazmín is excited: this afternoon she will have her first date in years. Filled with a nervous energy, she wonders what the day will bring – but as the minutes roll by, things do not turn out the way she had hoped…
